subject: Enclave network / IaC encapsulation review for on-prem private deployment
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmecloud.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@acmecloud.com
Date: 2027-06-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Enclave network / IaC encapsulation — request for review

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for taking a look at our private deployment plan. We built a thin private enclave topology to host the Redwood runtime inside our colocation racks; we want a clean IaC contract so your team can validate security assumptions before we sign off.

High level asks:
- Quick review of the Terraform modules that provision the VPC + subnet segmentation
- Helm values for the private ingress/controller and antrea CNI settings
- Short checklist on required audit artifacts for SOC2 readiness (network flow logs, bastion session recording, KMS usage)

I attached the current helm-values.yaml and a network-diagram.png. A couple of known constraints:
- We cannot open FTP/ICMP across enclaves; only control-plane egress allowed to the SaaS control plane on port 443.
- Our egress must be through a NAT cluster in the tenant DMZ.

Could your infra/security folks give an annotated pass (in-line notes or diff) and call out any gating CI checks we should add to our GitLab pipelines (terraform plan gating, helm values validation, ansible idempotency checks)?

Proposed cadence: 30–45 minute call with your infra lead + our ops next Tuesday.

Attachments: [helm-values.yaml (YAML)], [network-diagram.png (PNG)]

Thanks,
Tara Singh
Head of Infrastructure — AcmeCloud Solutions
(tara.singh@acmecloud.com)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ops@acmecloud.com
Date: 2027-06-10T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Enclave network / IaC encapsulation — request for review

Tara — thanks for the detailed note and artifacts. I ran a quick pass with Marissa and pulled in some early items before we schedule the call.

Immediate observations (high level):
- Terraform module boundaries: your VPC/subnet module looks fine but we recommend extracting a small "egress-gateway" module so the NAT cluster and route propagation are explicit and testable in isolation. That makes policy testing in CI easier.
- Helm values: ctl-plane callbacks (webhook URLs) are set to the hostnames in the diagram; you should add an env var toggle for CONTROL_PLANE_STRICT_TLS to fail-fast in CI if certs are missing.
- Ansible: I saw a few tasks that accept host keys without verification; switch to explicit known_hosts management.

I'll attach a minimal patch with inline comments (iac-diff.patch) and a short suggested GitLab pipeline snippet for the terraform/helm/ansible stages. Can you confirm whether you have a managed KMS (AWS KMS/GCP CMEK) or on-prem HSM — that changes the key rotation gating we recommend.

Proposed next steps:
1) We iterate on the diff (I can push a branch with our recommendations).
2) Quick async pass from Hannah (security/compliance) for SOC2 artifacts.
3) 30-min walkthrough next Tue (I can block 10:00–10:45 PT).

Attachments: [iac-diff.patch (diff)]

—
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmecloud.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ops@acmecloud.com
Date: 2027-06-12T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Enclave network / IaC encapsulation — request for review

Tara — thanks, this is a good starting point. A few compliance-oriented items I want cataloged before our call:

Inline notes / gating checklist (short):
- Network logging: confirm VPC flow logs retention policy and if they are exported to a customer-managed s3/gs bucket. We expect 90 days by default for our SOC2 scope.
- Bastion access: need keystroke/session capture or at least jumpbox SSH audit trail with timestamped user mapping.
- Key management: if you use on-prem HSM, provide rotation/backup docs and an operator contact. If managed KMS, give us the CMK ARN and default key policy.
- CI gating: add a terraform plan review step that fails merge when plan includes public_ip allocations or 0.0.0.0/0 routes; add a helm lint + kubeval stage for chart validation.
- Immutable artifacts: we prefer container images pinned by digest in values.yaml (no :latest).

Document artifacts we need before we can sign off on the deployment:
- network-diagram (annotated) with CIDR ranges (we only got a topology, not ranges) — we need explicit CIDRs for iptables and egress rules tests.
- terraform state access model and drift detection cadence (how will you enable read-only state access for audits?).
- list of service accounts with least-privilege IAM bindings for the runtime and the K8s control plane.

I attached a short audit_checklist.csv template you can fill in — it helps us map artifacts to our control families.

If you can reply with the KMS model and the annotated diagram by EOD Friday, we can lock the call for Tue and come with actionable notes.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmecloud.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, DevOps Team <ops@acmecloud.com>, David Wu <david.wu@infra-audit.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Enclave network / IaC encapsulation — request for review

Hannah / team — thanks for the thorough list. Quick answers and next artifacts:

- KMS: we use an on-prem HSM (Thales) managed by our security ops. I attached an annotated diagram with CIDRs and a short HSM access policy excerpt.
- Flow logs: exported to our tenant S3 bucket (retention 120 days) — I'll add the bucket policy to the checklist.
- Terraform state: we keep state in a locked S3 backend with DynamoDB locking and provide read-only roles for auditors.

I've uploaded the annotated diagram and a filled audit_checklist.csv to the Drive link below and attached the HSM policy snippet. Let's keep Tue 10:00–10:45 PT — David from InfraAudit will join to run a short perf/security checklist during the call.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-iac

Attachments: [network-diagram.png (annotated)], [audit_checklist.csv (filled)], [hsm-policy-snippet.txt]

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Tara
